I have 4 brothers and 1 sister. I dreamnt that we were living in a lone house, in the middle of a desert. Our car was parked some way away from the house. One night (in the dream) I went to the car and started the ignition. But instead of going forward the car raised up into the air. It kept rising up and reached a most beatiful place with abundant greenry, trees and breathtaking scenery. The grass was of a very rich colour and I remember a stream flowing some way away. I have not seen a place so beautiful in my lifetime. I heard my brothers calling from down below .. they said that "Mum is calling you" .. but I was so immersed in the beauty of the place that I refused to go back down. The scene changed: I was down again. It was another night and I went to the car again. I started the ignition again. The car rose but but was stopped 5-6 feet into the air.. My brothers had tied a rope to the back of the car and now they started pulling me back. i remember insisting on going up but they brought me down. I was really sad. I kept thinking about the place. On the 7th day after I had gone to the beautiful place, I looked at the moon and found a face on it. I was about 8-10 years old when I saw this dream. Now I'm almost 19. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 31876 Country: Pakistan Title: I was involved in a lot of haram activites. but lately i have reverted back to islam and have been repenting alot and have been praying regularly and have also started sitting with tableegh jamat and doing a lot of zikr. Question: I was involved in a lot of haram activites. but lately i have reverted back to islam and have been repenting alot and have been praying regularly and have also started sitting with tableegh jamat and doing a lot of zikr. i have also kept a beard, dont to plan to shave it again and planning to keep it fist long inshAllah. i dreamt that i was inside haram and had a glance at khana kaaba. i dont remember much from the dream, i cant recall what i felt in the dream but i do remember that i was actually over there standing infront of holy kaabah. can you please interpret the meaning of my dream? my second question is that my father, even though regularly prays, but is extremely against tableegh jamat. please tell me some useful zikr and duas which i should pray to Allah to change his heart because i really wanna go for tableegh and i want him to go as well. Answer ID: 31876 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 932/608/H=1432) (1) It is blessed and nice dream. In-sha-Allah, you shall be benefited by Tablighi Jama’ah if you follow all principles with sincerity. (2) You should take care of him and supplicate for him specially. Also, manage to convince him with the advice of local Tablighi Jamah elders with the intermediation of any suitable person, who shall make him understand with wisdom and foresight, it shall be useful for your father in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
